answer: A farm cannot fake the aggregate without controlling every key it names, thus paying the delta bond on all of them and exposing each to the knoll slash. Attestations are aggregated into one signature over 12 distinct keys, and the aggregate must verify against each key's registered public value. Because the raven audit verifies the aggregate, a single forged member invalidates the whole batch. A 229 account operation therefore ties up 12 million dollars of idle capital. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
